answer: Each identity is anchored to one basalt core drilled from a registered quarry: the core's mineral fingerprint is assayed once by an independent lab and hashed on-chain. A farm forging 100 identities must drill and assay 100 distinct cores at $340 and 6 lab-hours each, and the Raven audit network re-assays a random 5% of cores every epoch at the wharf depot, rejecting any duplicate fingerprint. One core cannot serve two identities, and bulk drilling cannot shortcut the per-core lab time.
